description:

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E9 — Knight Racer
A hateful man (William Windom) seeks revenge against the husband (John Crawford) of his former lover by sabotaging his race car. With David Hasselhoff, Jourdan Fremin, Norbert Weisser.

title: Knight Rider
description:

Michael (David Hasselhoff) goes undercover when a sinister man (Peter Brown) uses female prison inmates to commit robberies. With Julianne McNamara, Rosalind Ingledew.
